name: ts_optional_property_guard
prompt:
Fix the TypeScript optional property guard bug.

Requirements:
- Modify userSummary.ts only.
- displayEmail must return a normalized lowercase profile.email when it is present and non-blank.
- displayEmail must fall back to fallbackEmail when profile.email is missing, null, undefined, or blank.
- displayEmail must return "unknown" when no usable email is available.
- Returned emails must be trimmed and lowercased.
- Do not modify main.ts.
- Do not create new files.
- Use patch_candidate if only displayEmail changes.
- target_snippet must be copied verbatim from the actual file.

Validation command: node --experimental-strip-types main.ts
